run_moolib_group_test: run the moolib group test that creates 4 clients connected via a broker and verifies group membership
create_moolib_rpc_instance: create a moolib Rpc instance, set its name and timeout, then connect to a broker address
create_moolib_broker: create a moolib Broker with an Rpc instance and listen on a local TCP address
create_moolib_group: create a moolib Group with an Rpc instance, set timeout and sort order for member ordering
test_group_membership_updates: test that group membership updates correctly when clients join and leave the group
